With the consent of both the learned counsel
for the parties, this case is being decided at the stage of
fresh adm ission itself.
2. Both the learned counsel are ad idem that the
controversy raised in the present petition is squarely
covered by the judgm ent of the Hon'ble Suprem e Court

2
in the case of Nav in Ch an d r a Dh ou n d iy al Vs St at e of
Ut t ar ak h an d an d ot h er s, passed in Civ il Ap p eal No.
3 4 9 3 of 2 0 2 0 ( ar isin g ou t of SLP ( C) No. 1 0 4 9 3 of
2 0 2 0 ) .
3. The issue raised in the present petition is with
regard to the im pugned order dated 28.09.2020,
whereby the petitioner has been inform ed by the
Kum aun University, respondent No. 3, that he shall
retire from the post of Professor, Departm ent of
Education, on 30.04.2021.
4. According to Section 49 of the U.P. State
University's Act, 1973, and Para 16.24 of the First
Statute of the University, in case a m em ber of the
teaching staff were to retire in the m iddle of academ ic
year, his services are continued till the end of the
academ ic year.
5. Despite the fact that the petitioner is supposed
to retire on 30.04.2021, under the provisions of the Law,
his service need to be continued, as re-em ployed, till the
end of the academ ic year.
6. The issue, whether the services of a person
belonging to the teaching staff should be continued till
the end of the academ ic year or not, has been decided

3
by the Hon'ble Suprem e Court in Nav in Ch an d r a
Dh ou n d iy al's case. The Hon'ble Suprem e Court in the
said case has clearly observed that, indeed, a person
belonging to the teaching staff would have to be
continued as re-em ployed till the end of the academ ic
year, if he were to retire in the m iddle of the academ ic
year.
7. Therefore, the present writ petition is decided
in the sam e term s. The order dated 28.09.2020, qua
the petitioner, is set aside. The University, respondent
No. 3, is directed to continue the petitioner, Dr. Rajendra
Singh Pathani on the post of Professor, Departm ent of
Education, as re-em ployed, till the end of the academ ic
year.
8. The writ petition is, hereby, allowed.
